notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Tentacle.
It is not your turn.
The Watcher has zero stun counters on it.
description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping The Watcher, adding {U}.
Activate Drowned Rusalka by paying {U} and sacrificing a Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Drowned Rusalka trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
